about.summary: Laney College is a public community college in Oakland, California, United States. Laney is the largest of the four colleges of the Peralta Community College District which serves northern Alameda County. Laney College is named after Joseph Clarence Laney, a journalist who founded the Oakland Central Trade School. The college offers both certificates and credits for Associate of Arts degree, as well as prerequisites to transfer to four year universities. It is accredited by the Accrediting Commission for Community and Junior Colleges. Laney College is located in District 7 of the Peralta Community College District, which is represented by elected board trustee Sheweet Yohannes.

documents.title: Laney College 2018-2023 Strategic Plan
documents.summary: The Laney College Strategic Plan 2018-2023 establishes a comprehensive five-year roadmap for guiding college planning and decision-making processes. The plan is grounded in reaffirmation of the college's mission and vision, developed through extensive stakeholder engagement, and anchored in data-driven insights. It aims to promote equity, enhance institutional culture, offer high-quality curriculum and services, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and enhance access and support for disproportionately impacted communities.
